scope: Bounded official corporate and brand identity review. Green-star recommendations concern manufacturer identity and research-instrument business, not exact-model compatibility, current availability or performance. No canonical files modified.

manufacturers.claim: Official company page describes precision syringe-pump production since 1975, a California base and current medical/life-science instrument business. Its footer and group navigation identify Ingersoll Rand.
manufacturers.source_locator: About Us: company introduction; footer and group-brand links
manufacturers.notes: Retain historical Tri-Continent spelling as an alias. Current identity is verified; no claim that every cited old pump is still available.

manufacturers.claim: Official history dates the company to 1989, Halma acquisition to 2004, the Ocean Insight rebranding to 2019 and restoration of the Ocean Optics spectrometer brand to 2023. Current company page identifies Halma ownership.
manufacturers.notes: Ocean Insight is a historically related parent/umbrella name, not evidence that Ocean Optics is defunct. Preserve paper-era Ocean Optics attribution for Flame.

manufacturers.claim: Company page documents laboratory automation and microfluidics since 1991, ISO 9001 quality management and a Korbussen, Germany address.
manufacturers.source_locator: Company > High-End Microfluidics & Laboratory Automation; Quality & Service; address footer

manufacturers.claim: Lumibird identifies Quantel among its photonics brands. Official group history documents Quantel's 1970 origin, the 2017 Quantel/Keopsys combination and the 2018 Lumibird name.
manufacturers.source_locator: Lumibird company introduction; Universal Registration Document > Group History
manufacturers.notes: Use Quantel as the historical laser make, with Lumibird as its corporate successor/group. Do not mark the brand defunct merely because the group name changed. Do not conflate scientific Quantel lasers with separate medical-division ownership transactions.

manufacturers.verified_name: JPK Instruments AG / Bruker JPK BioAFM
manufacturers.claim: Bruker announced acquisition of Berlin-based JPK Instruments AG on July 12, 2018. Bruker continues to document the JPK BioAFM/NanoWizard product line.
manufacturers.source_locator: 2018 acquisition announcement; current JPK BioAFM product listing
manufacturers.notes: Keep the source-era JPK Instruments attribution on NanoWizard II, with a Bruker successor note. Acquisition is not grounds for marking the research brand illegitimate or defunct. No specific NanoWizard II replacement claim verified here.

manufacturers.claim: Official company site states establishment in 1994 and identifies a continuing range of electrochemical instrumentation for research and teaching.
manufacturers.notes: Shanghai Chenhua's site describes itself as the authorized China distributor of the US CH Instruments brand. Do not silently merge the Shanghai distributor's legal identity into the US manufacturer. Exact article attribution can retain the reported supplier name alongside normalized make.

manufacturers.claim: Liu 2019 directly names Anhui Best Equipment Technology with BTF-1200C. Other primary literature points to ahbeq.com for an Anhui Best equipment supplier, but the website timed out in this pass and did not establish the precise Best/BEQ/Beiyike legal-name equivalence.
manufacturers.source_locator: Liu 2019 Experimental Section 4.2; bounded official-web lookup
manufacturers.notes: Retain source-reported supplier identity and an unverified manufacturer star state. Do not guess BEQ or Beiyike normalization from translation similarity or distributor listings.
